note: What was actually run, so the roofline's dots are measurements rather than
estimates. One point per kernel at the full socket -- the thread sweep is in
RESULTS.md and would only crowd the plot.
The store's width is the kernel's template parameter, and these points are
the instantiation the generated Op publishes: metric_tensor_t (f32) for the
stored apply, compressed_t (f16) for the compressed one. The f64 store in
RESULTS.md is a benchmark-only instantiation; model it with
'--bind tangent_t=double', which is why that option exists.
Arithmetic is double throughout: s_t is double in every one of these.
Mesh ordering: morton3, the default, which is what SFEM's own benchmark drivers reorder with. See the ordering section of RESULTS.md for what the other orderings cost on these meshes.
